metadata.description: The Guava Stack for business owners and solo operators: guava-hub, one shared home in Notion for your AI context, a head-chef + line-cook model router through Claude Code and Codex, and founder-mode.

plugins.name: guava-hub
plugins.description: For business owners and solo operators. Sets up guava-hub, one shared home in Notion for your context, rules and skills, so Claude Code, Codex, Grok Bot and the Claude and ChatGPT apps share them. Part of the Guava Stack.

plugins.name: guava-router
plugins.description: For business owners and solo operators. Routes thinking work to a head-chef model through Claude Code and doing work to a line-cook model through Codex, on your Claude Pro and ChatGPT Plus plans or higher, and newer models swap in with a one-line change. Part of the Guava Stack.

plugins.name: founder-mode
plugins.description: For business owners and solo operators. 27 working rules so your AI assistant handles the safe work on its own and always checks with you before anything that could cost you money or can't be undone. Part of the Guava Stack.
